findings.evidence: A failing diagnostic request-intent append suppresses every known-session logout before transport. Header-diagnostic failure can also discard an already-returned token response. Cleanup transport must remain available while diagnostic health prevents all success and further ordinary activity.
The fixed auth boundary checks logout pathname but permits missing/global scope. Require scope=local so test cleanup cannot sign out other sessions.

limitations: Source/mock review only; full fresh post-37 evaluator positive remains unavailable until separately admitted read-only observation.
The local test loads retained synthetic failure evidence; it is not a portable CI test.
